ios.desc:
Snap a photo of your plate and let cutting-edge neural networks instantly recognize your meal, portion weight, calories, and complete macronutrient balance (protein, fats, carbs)!

NadY is your next-generation 2026 AI nutrition and wellness companion, engineered for anyone who wants to achieve their ideal body composition without tedious manual logging or searching clunky food databases.

WHY CHOOSE NADY?
• AI Vision 2.0: Simply point your camera. Our advanced vision model identifies multi-ingredient meals, hidden dressings, sauces, and sides in under a second.
• Bento Grid 2026: An ultra-clean, single-screen dashboard. Your calorie hero ring, macro targets, hydration level, and activity burn fit seamlessly into one intuitive view.
• Smart Intermittent Fasting: Track fasting protocols (16:8, 14:10, 18:6, 20:4) with clear visual milestones for fat burn, ketosis, and cellular renewal.
• Two-Way Apple Health Sync: Automatically pulls active energy burned and steps from Apple Watch, while writing meals and water directly to Apple Health.
• Net Calorie Deficit Engine: "Eaten − Burned = Net Balance." Monitor your true caloric deficit in real time to guarantee sustainable weight loss or muscle building.
• One-Tap Water Tracker: Stay hydrated with effortless tap-to-log water tracking.
• Interactive Portion Slider: Adjust serving sizes with a smooth slider, and your macros update dynamically.

WHO IS NADY FOR?
- Anyone tired of manual food scales and slow typing.
- Individuals seeking sustainable fat loss, weight maintenance, or lean muscle gain.
- Fans of intermittent fasting and flexible dieting (IIFYM).

WELLNESS DISCLAIMER:
NadY is a nutritional awareness and lifestyle tracking application. It is not intended for medical diagnosis, treatment, or clinical dietary prescriptions. Always consult a physician or certified dietitian before starting any significant dietary program.
